headline: Turn Daily Rite route-choice intelligence from readable advice into committed player agency without adding browser token cost.

items.title: Daily Rite route-choice commitments
items.why: Solara already opens route-choice prompts, but the player cannot yet commit to a route posture. Make the prompt a lightweight decision loop so every clear can become an authored survival, tempo, or shrine bargain choice.
items.recipe: Add a pure zero-token commitment builder, store the selected commitment on the active Daily Rite run, and render route-choice buttons in the Daily Rite status panel.

items.title: Route-choice feedback attribution
items.why: The local feedback ledger sees starts, ends, shares, imports, and room clears, but not player route posture. Recording the selected route choice gives future balancing a public-safe signal for ignored prompts, popular bargains, and confusing recommendations.
items.recipe: Emit a capped `daily_rite_route_choice` feedback event with route/source attribution when a choice is committed.

items.title: Route-choice commitment contract tests
items.why: The commitment surface accepts prompt data and choice ids that may eventually be hydrated from shared-world state. Add sanitizer, bounds, and status-contract tests now so the interaction remains public-safe as it becomes richer.
items.recipe: Cover commitment creation, invalid-choice fallback, status contract export, and feedback payload sanitization in the existing Daily Rite test suite.

executionLog.evidence: Added src/game/dailyRiteRouteCommitments.js, wired DailyRiteStatus commit controls, and persisted routeChoiceCommitment/routeChoiceHistory on active Daily Rite runs.
Route-choice commits emit capped public-safe daily_rite_route_choice feedback events with wave, action_id, source, and outcome attribution.
npm test passes 62/62, including commitment sanitizer, invalid-choice fallback, status contract export, and zero-token assertions.
